purpose: Quantify the full horizontal class before any full-class execution claim
native_tool: PARI/GP 2.15.2, Debian binary packages extracted outside the repository
input: Delta_pi=-6649310858224389603, verified factorization and conductor in the native driver
operation: Run qfbclassno on the exact negative discriminant, record algorithm documentation and both available algorithms where feasible. Verify primality/factorization separately. Treat any conditional guarantee explicitly.
limits: 300 seconds per class-number command; retain timeout/stack failures; no full class walk is started merely by computing the class number.
interpretation: For a certified fundamental discriminant, the ordinary isogeny class has one endomorphism order and its number of Fp-isomorphism classes is h(D). This is a finite-class size, not the number of all isogeny maps or degrees.
